_source: Copilot runtime 1.0.94 (the Copilot CLI and VS Code's Copilot agent host share it). preToolUse input fields (sessionId, timestamp, cwd, toolName, toolArgs) and the deny output (permissionDecision, permissionDecisionReason) from docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-configuration and code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/hooks (read 2026-11-21). The tool name ask_user from microsoft/vscode at eed41ffe (src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/copilot/copilotBuiltinToolAllowlist.ts); its arguments {question, choices, allowFreeform} from the SDK's user-input handler there (copilotAgentSession.ts), with choices a list of strings per the installed runtime's own validation strings (runtime.node) and question read by the installed cli-main.js. The arguments are not verified against the runtime's hook payload itself. Values are synthetic.

toolArgs.question: Should the migration run before or after the deploy?
